Description

This resource will provide analysis, development, testing, and implementation in support of Central Accounts Payable System (CAPS) and Administrative Management Reporting Application (AMRA), used for Administration of Financial Operations. CAPS integrates with critical applications such as NYS Commission for Blind (NYSCB), Juvenile Justice Information System (JJIS), Quality Youth Development System (QYDS), Leave and Accrual Tracking System (LATS-NY), Human Capital Management (HCM-NY), and Contract Management System (CMS). Authorized payments are transferred to the NYS Statewide Financial System (SFS) for payment via SFTP. The resulting return payment files are unencrypted, parsed and provide payment details for OCFS feeder system reconciliation. Timely payment processing to the vendors is very critical to continue to get the services and supplies. The failure to make payments could cause the termination of the services which will impact on the health and safety of the clients in care. CAPS has near real time integration with other critical agency applications. These applications work together to help the agency safeguard the clients that it is chartered to protect.

Work in coordination with a team of developers to code the current .Net applications in latest version.

The individual in this position will work under the direction of a Portfolio Manager.
Perform writing of complex stored procedures/triggers in an Oracle database utilizing PL/SQL.

Experience (14+ Years)
Develops and implements applications and programs for the backend processing systems used in businesses and organizations.

THIS IS A DEPARMENTAL PROMOTIONAL OPPORTUNITY. ONLY CURRENT EMPLOYEES OF THE HAMILTON COUNTY INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY DEPARTMENT WILL BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION.

Under general supervision, designs, develops, and maintains computer systems for various departments of Hamilton County Government to ensure accurate informational processes and reports, may serve in a lead role.

Tasks

Work requires a high degree of independent judgment, technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and knowledge of modern software development practices. The position works closely with IT staff, department personnel, end users, vendors, and other stakeholders to develop and maintain applications that support critical government operations.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics

Knowledge of federal, state and county laws, rules, regulations, practices and procedures related to telecommunications and computer programming applications.

Knowledge of high-level technical hardware and software programming analysis methods and practices.

Knowledge of high-level technical programming maintenance and repair.

Knowledge of Microsoft .Net development technologies.

Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and relational database concepts.

Knowledge of C#, VB.NET, Blazor, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, and related Microsoft technologies.

Knowledge of programming and design methods, practices and procedures.

Knowledge of customer service/public relations practices.

Skill analyzing customer/client needs.

Skill reading and writing C# and/or VB.NET code.

Skill developing and optimizing complex SQL queries and database operations.

Skill creating, designing, programming, implementing, and troubleshooting program applications.

Skill providing technical support and training to staff and end users.

Skill utilizing verbal and written communication to develop and present reports, training and presentations related to programming needs or innovations.

Skill learning and implementing new technologies to better serve the end user.

Skill utilizing customer service/public relations techniques when responding to inquiries and complaints.

Skill establishing and maintaining effective working relationships.

Skill effectively communicating in both oral and written form.

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science plus five (5) years of programming and systems design experience. A valid driver’s license is required.

OR

An Associate’s Degree in Computer Science plus seven (7) years of programming and systems design experience. A valid driver’s license is required.

OR

The equivalent of a high school diploma and nine (9) years of programming and systems design experience. A valid driver’s license is required.

Additional Requirements

Prior to operating a County-owned vehicle, all employees are required to complete the HC Defensive Driving course and/or an Emergency Vehicle Operations Course (EVOC) provided at the department level.

Physical Requirements

Work requires attention to detail and extensive computer keyboarding. May require working evenings and weekends and being on call.
